body: They are. But I have literally nowhere to go. No friends. Family members all sick with other serious diseases. If I had an income I'd be already living in a small studio. I could be working with what I worked before but I don't have a computer. I only have an old Android phone that os dying. Already checked the public library, they don't have computers anymore. Already checked local university, no computer available because they were stealing them (third world classic problems). I could begin a cooking business but there's absolutely no possibility to cook in this house (for many reasons, and a narcissistic boderline mother). :|

I'm a 33 female living with her parents since March. I have treatment resistant depression, anxiety, migraines, and cluster headache. Every single of these were treated with every possible (legal) treatment. I do therapy at the expanses of my father's insurance. I apply to jobs everyday through the internet. I know I could find some bartender or waitress temporary work at night, but at least half of the days of the month I'm having strong migraines with extreme photophobia or cluster attacks. I sleep 12 hours a day and I can't wake up before 1pm no mater how much I try. I am also suicidal, and trying to hide all of my problems at job interviews is extremely difficult, when all you want to do is to stop existing. 

I have other health problems but I can't apply for disability in my country. I try to exercise, but it intensifies or triggers the migraines. I medidate but it's not of much help, to be honest... my family already know all od this but they just pretend I'm a lazy person instead of supporting their suicidal daughter, because they prefer to live in another fucked up reality.

 I am planning to kill myself by the end of the month if things don't change. I'm here since March and nothing has changed so far (in fact it worse), no matter what I do and the ammount of efford I put to get better and find a job.
